prompt: Your family is excitedly fixing dates for a big shared trip in the group chat, but the chosen week clashes with an important course deadline you have. Everyone else has already agreed. What response best raises it fairly?

options.text: Say nothing in the chat and quietly plan not to go
Demand the whole trip moves, since your deadline matters most
Speak up promptly in the chat, explain the clash, and suggest one or two nearby alternative weeks that could work for everyone
Agree enthusiastically now and hope the deadline moves

explanation: Speaking up early with alternatives gives the family a real chance to include you, instead of a late surprise or silent withdrawal.
